definition: Paul Kruszewski (born 1967) is a Canadian AI technologist and serial entrepreneur known for his work in artificial intelligence and computer graphics.
details: He has previously founded and sold three AI startups, specializing in crowd simulation, NPC behaviours, and human pose estimation.

explainer.lead: Paul Kruszewski is a Canadian AI technologist and serial entrepreneur.

contributions.name: After completing his thesis, Kruszewski developed and commercialized the software, naming it the "Tree Druid."

timeline.what: For graduate school, Kruszewski received a Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada (NSERC) Science and Engineering scholarship in 1992.
